videos.title: Android screens
videos.description: Short 10-second clip — reaches the end quickly, so you can watch the feed advance to the next reel on its own.

videos.title: Quality ladder
videos.description: Two renditions (480p, 240p) of the same video. Pick a quality in the player options, or leave Auto and it steps down by itself when buffering lasts more than 5 seconds. Video only, no audio track.

videos.title: Big Buck Bunny
videos.description: Blender open movie at 320×180, about 10 minutes — small file, decodes everywhere.

videos.title: Dizzy
videos.description: 25-second 480×360 clip with an embedded tx3g subtitle track.

videos.title: Android screens (25s)
videos.description: Longer cut of the screens clip.

videos.title: Big Buck Bunny (HEVC)
videos.description: 12-second 760×480 HEVC encode, video only — checks H.265 hardware decoding.

videos.title: Frame counter (1 hour)
videos.description: One-hour frame counter. Seek ahead, leave the player and come back: it resumes from where you stopped.
